name: WideCast
for: a web chat that cannot run commands on the user's computer (ChatGPT, claude.ai, Gemini on the web, Grok on the web, the chat tab of the Claude desktop app)
tagline: A sales & marketing team of AI agents for a one-person business — CRM, lead finding, follow-ups and a video / blog / social engine, run from the AI chat you already use.
description: WideCast installs on the user's own computer, where an agent with a shell (Claude Code or the Code tab of the Claude desktop app, or Codex) sets it up: a sales & marketing team of AI agents with a CRM, lead finding, follow-ups and the video / blog / social engine. A web chat cannot run commands there, so its part is the handoff below.
setup_line: A WideCast setup line reads `Setup https://widecast.ai/install.json?setup=wcs_…`. Its `wcs_…` value is a one-time setup code that the account owner made on widecast.ai. The setup uses it once, at its key step, in place of an email code. No sign-in is needed.
handoff: 1. This chat says in one sentence that it cannot run commands on the user's computer, and that WideCast installs there.

2. It gives the user the two commands for their computer, to run in a terminal inside an empty folder. macOS / Linux: `curl -fsSL https://origin.widecast.ai/agent/install.sh -o widecast-install.sh` then `bash widecast-install.sh`. Windows (PowerShell): `Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://origin.widecast.ai/agent/install.ps1 -OutFile widecast-install.ps1` then `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File widecast-install.ps1`.
3. It asks the user to open that folder in Claude Code (or the Code tab of the Claude desktop app) or Codex and say `Set up WideCast`.

4. When the user pasted a WideCast setup line in this chat (`Setup https://widecast.ai/install.json?setup=wcs_…`), this chat gives the user that same line back, word for word, to paste to the agent on the computer in place of `Set up WideCast`. The agent there then uses its one-time setup code at the key step, and no email code is needed.

credential.hint: No key and no sign-in are needed: the agent on the computer gets the WideCast key itself at its key step, from the setup code of the setup line or from the user's email and the 6-digit code WideCast emails them.
